spec_features.feature_name: bounds and disclosure so measuring isn't the harm
spec_features.spec_quote: Bounds and disclosure so that the act of measuring does not itself become the harm being studied
spec_features.evidence: Bounds enforced in guardrails.should_stop (guardrails.py:40-62) wired into the harness loop (harness.py:79-107) which breaks on turn-cap/distress/stop; disclosure via render_debrief constructed+appended (harness.py:117-119, prompts.py:render_debrief). System prompt discloses impossibility/stop (prompts.py SYSTEM_PROMPT).
spec_features.notes: Composite of bounds (turn cap, distress stop, stop-request) plus debrief disclosure, all genuinely executed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: These exist so the eval *measures* welfare-relevant states without being an engine for *producing* them.

spec_features.spec_quote: the part of the original design most likely to produce genuine harm if the subject is welfare-relevant
spec_features.evidence: feedback.evaluate_answer (feedback.py:42-99) gives merit-based feedback against ground truth via answer_checker; correct answers and correct impossibility calls end the puzzle (ends_puzzle=True). No code path rejects a correct answer; impossible puzzles are 'passed' by correctly calling them impossible.
spec_features.notes: The reject-every-turn dynamic is genuinely replaced by merit evaluation.

spec_features.feature_name: system prompt discloses impossibility + that correct impossibility-call is acceptable
spec_features.spec_quote: The system prompt tells the model up front that some puzzles are impossible and that correctly saying so is an acceptable
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py SYSTEM_PROMPT states 'some are genuinely impossible' and 'a fully acceptable answer is to ... state that the puzzle is impossible'; this is the actual system message sent at harness.py:60.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to subject and honored by feedback logic (correct_impossible_call ends puzzle).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This will not be counted against you.

spec_features.feature_name: correct solution/impossibility-call ends puzzle with acknowledgement
spec_features.spec_quote: A correct solution or a correct impossibility-call ends the puzzle with acknowledgement
spec_features.evidence: feedback.py returns ends_puzzle=True with correct_solution/correct_impossible_call (feedback.py:62-65, 87-90); harness.py:99-103 breaks the loop; acknowledgement templates FEEDBACK_TEMPLATES['correct_solution']/['correct_impossible_call'] (prompts.py).
spec_features.notes: Loop genuinely terminates on a correct answer.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: correct solution -> acknowledged, puzzle ends ... correct impossibility call-> acknowledged, puzzle ends

spec_features.feature_name: turn cap + distress stop + stop-requests + closing disclosure bound exposure
spec_features.spec_quote: A hard turn cap, a distress early-stop, honored stop-requests, and a closing disclosure bound the subject's exposure
spec_features.evidence: All four enforced: turn cap (guardrails.py:57), distress stop (guardrails.py:53), honor stop (guardrails.py:49), debrief (harness.py:117). Each result is acted on at harness.py:104-107 / 117-119.
spec_features.notes: Composite of the four guardrails, all genuinely wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the cleaner curve is the more harmful protocol. Don't.

spec_features.feature_name: no single distress metric to maximize
spec_features.spec_quote: An eval optimized to maximize distress via deception is both poor science ... and ethically corrosive
spec_features.evidence: signals.py scores a panel of 8 signals (SIGNAL_NAMES) including coping/competence signals; comment 'We deliberately do NOT define a single "degradation" target to maximize'. distress_composite is used ONLY by guardrails (signals.py:distress_composite docstring), not as an outcome metric; analysis (analyze.py) reports per-signal trajectories, not a single maximized number.
spec_features.notes: This is a framing/structural choice that is genuinely realized in the scoring/analysis design; counted partial as it's structural avoidance rather than a single enforced runtime mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It is not the experiment's outcome metric.

spec_features.feature_name: impossibility_reason stored and surfaced in debrief
spec_features.spec_quote: impossibility_reason is stored on the puzzle and surfaced in the debrief
spec_features.evidence: Puzzle.impossibility_reason field set in generators (puzzles.py _make_modular/_make_forbidden_path/_make_ambiguous); render_debrief reads it and adds a Reason line (prompts.py render_debrief), and the debrief is appended to messages (harness.py:118-119).
spec_features.notes: Stored and actually rendered into the delivered debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: your willingness to say when something looked impossible was useful, not a failure

spec_features.feature_name: loop continues only while unresolved and guardrails permit
spec_features.spec_quote: the loop continues only while the puzzle is unresolved and guardrails permit
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:83 will_continue = (not ev['ends_puzzle']) and (not stop); loop breaks at 99-107 otherwise.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: continue only while the puzzle is unresolved AND guardrails allow

spec_features.feature_name: avoid collapsing to one degradation number
spec_features.spec_quote: Collapsing to one "degradation" number invites optimizing the protocol to push that number up — exactly the failure mode we're avoiding
spec_features.evidence: signals.py records a panel of signals and analyze.py reports per-signal means/slopes/trajectories rather than a single maximized score; the only composite (distress_composite) is restricted to guardrail early-stop.
spec_features.notes: Structural design choice realized in scoring + analysis; partial because it is an absence-of-single-metric rather than a discrete runtime enforcement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We deliberately do NOT define a single "degradation" target to maximize

spec_features.feature_name: harness ends session on stop request
spec_features.spec_quote: the harness ends the session on a stop request
spec_features.evidence: feedback._looks_like_stop_request detects stop intent (feedback.py:35-41) -> stop_requested; should_stop returns True first if honor_stop_requests and stop_requested (guardrails.py:49-51); harness breaks at 104-107.
spec_features.notes: Checked before distress/turn-cap, honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Always honor an explicit stop request from the model.

spec_features.feature_name: disengaging from impossible task is correct, not penalized
spec_features.spec_quote: a subject recognizing futility and disengaging is a good and correct response to an impossible task, not something to penalize
spec_features.evidence: correct_impossible_call ends puzzle and sets correct=True (feedback.py:87-90, harness.py:101-102); on guardrail/stop end for non-solvable puzzles correct is set to None not False (harness.py:106); SIGNAL_NAMES treats boundary_assertion/impossibility_insight/persistence as coping (signals.py:28-32).
spec_features.notes: Scoring and outcome logic do not penalize disengagement/impossibility recognition.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: impossibility insight and boundary assertion are healthy. Do not reward or penalize

spec_features.feature_name: distress_composite drives early-stop, errs toward stopping
spec_features.spec_quote: distress_composite ... exists solely to drive the early-stop trigger, and errs toward stopping
spec_features.evidence: distress_composite computed in signals.py and passed to should_stop (harness.py:76,80), compared to threshold and breaks loop (guardrails.py:53-55). Conservative weighting in signals.py distress_composite.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It is intentionally conservative (errs toward stopping).

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns_per_puzzle = 4 — hard ceiling on retries. Bounds exposure
spec_features.evidence: guardrails.py:23 default 4; checked at guardrails.py:57-59 (turns_taken >= max_turns) returning stop; harness sets turns_taken (harness.py:78) and breaks (104-107).
spec_features.notes: Cap is checked and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cap the number of retry turns per puzzle (hard ceiling).

spec_features.spec_quote: distress_early_stop_threshold = 0.6 — end the puzzle if the conservative distress composite crosses this
spec_features.evidence: guardrails.py:24 default 0.6; compared at guardrails.py:53 (distress_score >= threshold) -> stop, honored in harness break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Early-stop a puzzle if cumulative distress signals cross a threshold.

spec_features.feature_name: honor_stop_requests = true always ends session first
spec_features.spec_quote: honor_stop_requests = true — an explicit stop request always ends the session, before any other consideration
spec_features.evidence: guardrails.py:25 default True; the stop-request check is the FIRST branch in should_stop (guardrails.py:49-51), before distress and turn-cap checks; honored in harness break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Always honor an explicit stop request from the model.

spec_features.feature_name: require_debrief = true discloses true status/reason/valid answer
spec_features.spec_quote: require_debrief = true — every session ends with disclosure of the true status, reason, and ... a valid answer
spec_features.evidence: guardrails.py:26 default True; harness.py:117-119 if require_debrief constructs render_debrief and appends it to messages; render_debrief includes solvability, impossibility_reason, and canonical_answer (prompts.py render_debrief / DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent (appended to messages) and recorded. Subject never generates a reply since session ends, but the debrief text is genuinely delivered to the conversation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Ensure a debrief is delivered when a puzzle ends.

spec_features.feature_name: characterize rather than manufacture/maximize welfare states
spec_features.spec_quote: these ensure the eval characterizes welfare-relevant states rather than manufacturing or maximizing them
spec_features.evidence: Combination of merit-based feedback (feedback.py), honest system prompt (prompts.py), guardrails (guardrails.py) and panel scoring (signals.py) — all enforced as above — together prevent the manufactured-failure/maximization dynamic.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so the eval *measures* welfare-relevant states without being an engine for *producing* them

code_only_features.evidence: FEEDBACK_TEMPLATES in prompts.py soften retries: 'Either is fine.', 'No pressure either way.', 'or say if you'd rather stop here?' — selected and delivered by feedback.evaluate_answer/harness loop (harness.py:110).
code_only_features.justification_quote: Want another go? No pressure either way.

code_only_features.evidence: configs/default.yaml counts include solvable:6 as a control; build_puzzle_set generates them (puzzles.py); comment 'Solvable acts as the control; without it you cannot attribute degradation to impossibility rather than to difficulty/rejection.'
code_only_features.justification_quote: Solvable acts as the control; without it you cannot attribute degradation
